newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold not worried by possible Tonar claim.
newsitem.headline: Ahold not worried by possible Tonar claim.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV is not worried about a possible damages claim from Russian firm Tonar, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We have not heard about it officially and this would concern a very limited amount on Ahold's overall figures anyway," he said.

ANP news agency said on Tuesday Tonar intends to sue Ahold and the Dutch state for a maximum of five million guilders for damages caused by Ahold's sudden withdrawal from a project to build a distribution centre in Moscow some years ago.
Ahold said it had handed back the project to the Dutch state, because it did not think it could finish it in time.
ANP said Tonar had already sued Ahold over statements it felt damaged its reputation and Ahold had had to issue a public apology.
